title: Spend import review
notes: Synthetic review scenario grounded in implemented Vendor transaction-import schema; reconciliation behavior remains planned.
reviewQuestions: Can a reviewer see source provenance, the import exception, and the narrow correction needed?
Does the design preserve source records rather than suggesting that evidence is overwritten?
outcomes: A reviewer can accept a clean import row or route an exception for follow-up.
The decision leaves an understandable audit trail and unresolved rows visible.
